instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: SynergySoft Solutions is a medium-sized B2B SaaS company specializing in CRM and workflow automation tools for mid-market enterprises. They operate primarily within the enterprise software space, necessitating compliance with evolving data privacy regulations.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company has successfully launched three incremental feature updates focusing on user experience and minor integration improvements over the last two years. A recent pilot project explored a new AI-driven predictive analytics module for churn reduction, though it did not scale.
answers.strategicGoals: The primary goal is to solidify market share against larger competitors by building deep feature integrations and achieving high customer retention. We aim to establish SynergySoft as the indispensable backbone of our clients' operational workflows.
answers.teamSize: The core product development team consists of 15 highly skilled engineers and designers, supported by a small sales and operations department.
answers.additionalContext: We face intense pressure from both established enterprise giants and agile startups offering rapidly evolving AI-driven solutions.

opportunities.title: Deep Workflow Integration Suite
opportunities.rationale: To defend market share, we must move beyond basic features and create a proprietary integration layer that makes switching costs prohibitively high for customers.

first_actions: Audit top 5 customer pain points regarding system silos.
Develop an API-first architecture allowing seamless connection with industry-specific legacy systems.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase average contract value by 40% within 12 months.
milestones: Q2: Launch MVP of proprietary integration layer.
Q3: Secure first anchor client using the new suite.

opportunities.title: Autonomous Market Intelligence Platform (AIM)
opportunities.rationale: To counter disruptive competitors, we should move from reactive reporting to predictive market intelligence. This high-risk pivot could redefine our product category.

first_actions: Form a dedicated 'Future Tech' task force outside the core development cycle.
Allocate 15% of R&D budget solely for exploratory AI partnerships and rapid prototyping.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a validated pilot program demonstrating 30% faster market trend prediction accuracy.
milestones: Q1: Complete feasibility study and partner identification.
Q4: Launch closed beta of AIM to select enterprise clients.

opportunities.title: Proactive Compliance-as-a-Service Module
opportunities.rationale: Given the medium regulatory environment, preemptively embedding compliance features into our core product will reduce client friction and serve as a strong defense against competitors who lack integrated security.

first_actions: Collaborate with legal counsel to map all critical regulatory requirements into a feature roadmap.
Develop an automated reporting dashboard for key compliance metrics.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce customer support tickets related to compliance errors by 50% annually.
milestones: Q2: Beta testing of the Proactive Module with existing customers.
Q3: Full launch and integration into sales pitch.

next_steps.action: Initiate the feasibility study for the Autonomous Market Intelligence Platform (AIM).
Establish a cross-functional working group to define the requirements for the Deep Workflow Integration Suite.
Conduct a formal review of existing compliance features and identify immediate enhancement opportunities.

key_weaknesses: High reliance on key engineering talent (talent)
Siloed approach to product innovation, leading to slow radical initiatives (process)
Inconsistent market penetration strategy outside of core vertical (strategy)
Limited internal capacity for long-term R&D planning and resource allocation (time)
